strings.notes: US 0672/0; 埃米 = 0719 #151 Emmy (US contact Erin); refers to herself in the third person (埃米)

strings.zh: 败给你{NEWLINE}真是窝心啊！{CLEAR}埃米一定要更加努力⋯⋯{SCROLL}你把电话号码给埃米吧,{NEWLINE}埃米以后还想和你对战！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Losing to you really stings!{NEWLINE}Emmy has to try even harder...{SCROLL}Give Emmy your phone number!{NEWLINE}Emmy wants to battle you again!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等埃米想对战的时候{NEWLINE}埃米一定会打电话给你的！
strings.en: Emmy will call you whenever{NEWLINE}Emmy wants to battle!

strings.zh: 哎？好无聊啊！{NEWLINE}算了,等你有兴趣了{CLEAR}再来埃米这里吧！
strings.en: Huh? Boo, that’s no fun! Oh well, come{NEWLINE}find Emmy when you’re interested!

strings.zh: 好想再来比一场啊！{NEWLINE}要登录电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Emmy really wants another match!{NEWLINE}Want to register your number?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 又输了！{NEWLINE}这是我第几次输了啊。{SCROLL}但很谢谢你能过来！{NEWLINE}这个是给你的礼物！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Aww... I lost again!{NEWLINE}I wonder how many times that is...{SCROLL}Thanks for coming!{NEWLINE}Here’s a present!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 怎么了？{NEWLINE}就在附近怎么还打电话？{CLEAR}埃米不害怕啦,{CLEAR}你直接来和埃米见面吧。
strings.en: What’s up? Why call when you’re right{NEWLINE}nearby? Emmy’s not scared!{SCROLL}Just come see Emmy in person.
strings.notes: US 0672/6 | RV072: meaning: 不害怕 = Emmy isn't scared (D-1899)

strings.zh: 说起埃米的{VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}它现在比以前强多了。{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: Emmy’s {VAR:0100:10} is way{NEWLINE}stronger than it used to be.{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 喂喂,{SCROLL}刚才埃米和{VAR:0100:11}战斗,{NEWLINE}居然赢了！{SCROLL}果然埃米的培育是有成效的！{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: Hey, hey!{SCROLL}Emmy just battled a{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}, and we won!{SCROLL}Emmy’s training really is paying off!{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 那个那个,{SCROLL}又被{VAR:0100:11}逃掉了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}好讨厌的感觉啊！{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: Um, um...{SCROLL}A {VAR:0100:11} got away{NEWLINE}again... That feels awful!{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 和埃米再来一场{NEWLINE}对战怎么样？{CLEAR}埃米在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: How about another battle{NEWLINE}with Emmy? Emmy’s waiting for{CLEAR}you at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 啊,{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}快点来和埃米对战吧！{SCROLL}埃米在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你！
strings.en: Oh, {VAR:0103:0}, hurry up{NEWLINE}and come battle Emmy!{SCROLL}Emmy’s waiting for you{NEWLINE}at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 埃米现在要把自己的{NEWLINE}精灵培养得更强大！{SCROLL}下次我们再来比一场！
strings.en: Emmy is going to raise her{NEWLINE}Pokémon to be even stronger!{SCROLL}Let’s have another match next time!
